translations.m_f51fce2b9d36: This page explains the information users provide through the Basstahali website, how contact options work, how browsing preferences are saved, and how external services are used. It helps parents and teachers understand the information they choose to share when using the website.
translations.m_bcae5e4a07ec: The teacher application form asks for a full name, email address, password, WhatsApp number, payout method and payout account details, as well as the curriculum, school stage and subjects the teacher teaches.
translations.m_540927b5fb69: When you submit the teacher application form, the information you entered is sent to Basstahali as part of your application. Please provide accurate details and limit your submission to the information requested by the form.
translations.m_758d17649636: Teacher details, teaching selections and payout information are included in the application. Curriculum, stage and subject selections identify what the teacher offers. Browsing the public curriculum lists does not require submitting a teacher application.
translations.m_2c7efb14c290: The application status page displays the status returned by the service when checking an application number. The service may require the registered WhatsApp number to validate the enquiry. Keep your application number and avoid posting it alongside your personal information in public places.
translations.m_527246fc4d6b: The contact form lets you enter a name, phone number, email address, subject and message. Its button opens a draft addressed to basstahali@gmail.com in your email application and includes the form details in the message. You can review it before sending it from your email application; the website does not send the message on your behalf.
translations.m_96e57725b13c: Enquiry and subscription links open WhatsApp for +971 56 330 6087 and may include a prepared message about the package or service you selected. Review the message before sending it. Email and WhatsApp use is also subject to those providers’ policies and settings.
translations.m_7d1fdb12e082: The site stores your Arabic or English language choice and light or dark theme preference in your browser’s local storage for future visits in the same browser.
translations.m_3a7aedca421f: The packages page reads your device’s time zone from your browser. Prices appear in EGP at a fixed rate of 15 Egyptian pounds per dirham when the time zone is Cairo (Africa/Cairo); they appear in AED for other time zones or if the time zone cannot be read. This uses your device settings and does not require location permission or determine your country from your IP address.
translations.m_4c590c659be8: You can change these preferences using the website controls or remove website data in your browser settings. Removing browser data resets local preferences and does not delete applications already submitted to the service.
translations.m_0b23eea99bcf: Some images, icons and display resources may load from external services, including DiceBear, Unsplash and cdnjs. The page also includes an external Google AdSense script. Loading an external resource creates a connection to its provider, and the request may include information such as a network address and browser type. The provider’s policy governs its processing of these requests.
translations.m_e18a2109f5bf: External services may use cookies according to their policies and settings. You can manage or block these cookies in your browser settings, although this may affect some features of external services.
translations.m_774d76e8f694: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp links take you to services outside the Basstahali website. Review the external service’s privacy policy and sharing settings before sending personal information or following accounts through it.
translations.m_2ebd2b79096c: Because the learning service may be used by younger students, we encourage parents or guardians to take part in choosing lessons, reviewing communications and bookings, and helping students decide what information is appropriate to share.
translations.m_7221a6965d41: Share only the information needed for an enquiry or to arrange learning. Avoid sending private student images, identity documents or sensitive health information through messages, and review what the student shares with external services.
translations.m_2862b895fc5b: Use a password that you do not use for other accounts, and do not send it by email or WhatsApp. Enter the requested payout information in the teacher form fields, and avoid entering passwords for financial services or card PINs.
translations.m_b1aa0359563a: Enquiries and requests to correct information
translations.m_c7983029e49f: If you have a question about this page or would like to request a correction to information you provided, contact basstahali@gmail.com or WhatsApp +971 56 330 6087. Briefly explain your request and the correction you are seeking, and include an application number when needed without attaching a password or sensitive financial information.
translations.m_592918b57dd2: These terms explain how to use Basstahali, enquire about live online private lesson packages, and arrange a subscription. Please read them and confirm the package details with our team before confirming your subscription.
translations.m_069cbdbdf83c: Basstahali is a platform for live online private lessons that helps students understand their school subjects and interact with their teachers. Use the platform and its associated communication channels for educational purposes and to arrange lessons.
translations.m_64673d0fd534: If a student is a minor, their parent or guardian must coordinate the subscription, confirm its details, and contact the team when needed, while overseeing the student’s use of the platform and participation in lessons.
translations.m_f4a278e834f9: Provide accurate information when contacting us, registering, or requesting a subscription, and tell the team if information needed to arrange lessons or contact you changes. Keep your login credentials confidential.
translations.m_7f590f05b0f6: Applicants to join our teachers must provide accurate information about themselves and the subjects and curricula they wish to teach. Submitting an application or receiving an application number does not mean acceptance; the outcome can be checked through application tracking or by contacting the team.
translations.m_d32b8dc711f5: The packages page presents International curriculum and UAE Ministry curriculum offers by school stage. The published packages include 4 school subjects and 1 extra subject for free, with 8 lessons per subject. Package prices for visitors from Egypt are shown in EGP at a fixed conversion of EGP 15 per AED; visitors from other countries see prices in UAE dirhams.
translations.m_421bfa14f51b: Review the package details, price, and offer shown on the packages page, then confirm the subjects you will study and the appropriate school stage and curriculum with the team before subscribing.
translations.m_208f13e387cd: Arranging a subscription and confirming details
translations.m_2b6fdf41bc73: The subscription button opens WhatsApp to contact the Basstahali team about the selected package. Before making any payment, confirm the subjects, number of lessons, schedule, and final package price with the team.
translations.m_ff615e7ea02f: Keep your subscription details confirmation and related correspondence so you can refer to them when arranging lessons or requesting help.
translations.m_d556d581508d: Lesson times are arranged with the team according to the agreed subjects and package. Attend at the confirmed times, and contact us early if you have difficulty attending or need to request a schedule change.
translations.m_a1aa7d3c54c2: To participate in live lessons, prepare a suitable device and an internet connection that allows you to follow the explanation and interact, and tell the team if a technical issue affects your attendance.
translations.m_82f7bec69f36: Treat teachers, students, and the support team respectfully. Avoid abuse, bullying, disrupting lessons, or sending inappropriate content, and help maintain an environment where everyone can learn.
translations.m_75670425d887: Respect participants’ privacy and do not publish their contact details, images, or conversations without their permission. Direct lesson-related questions or issues to the Basstahali team.
translations.m_b9b82a2f0dce: Content and educational materials remain the property of their respective rights holders. Use materials made available to you in lessons for your personal learning, and do not share, republish, or sell them without the rights holder’s permission.
translations.m_32daafd40a3c: Do not record or capture lessons, or share lesson recordings, without permission from the content rights holders and the participants concerned.
translations.m_67f0c76636b5: Before confirming your subscription, ask the team to explain the cancellation, rescheduling, and refund conditions that apply to your selected package. If you wish to change your subscription or encounter an issue after confirmation, contact the team to explain your request and review the agreed details.
translations.m_ebcfd555374e: For questions about these terms or subscription details, contact us on WhatsApp at +971563306087 or by email at basstahali@gmail.com.
